title: Crypto Trading Signals - March 28, 2026
top_story_headline: Tether's $6.8B equity buffer leaves USDT just one 30% gold drawdown from balance-sheet insolvency, per FT
top_story_comment: $22.8B in gold + BTC against a $6.8B buffer is a ~3.3x leverage ratio on volatile collateral — but the real math people keep ignoring is the corporate structure. Tether International (the issuer) sits under a parent with ~$30B in group equity and $500M/month in Treasury yield income, so a 30% drawdown doesn't trigger actual liquidation unless regulators prevent the parent from downstream capital injection. That's the bet: not whether gold crashes, but whether incoming stablecoin legislation (MiCA, US GENIUS Act) will enforce strict entity-level capital requirements that make the parent backstop legally irrelevant. Meanwhile Tether bought 26 tonnes of gold in Q3 2025 alone — more than any central bank — actively increasing concentration into the exact asset class that defines their insolvency threshold.
